dedupe_keys.name: bhtrans belo horizonte transport and traffic open data

description: BHTRANS, the transport and traffic company of the city of Belo Horizonte, publishes 24 datasets on the city's open data portal. They include the road circulation network with its node file, traffic signals, speed humps, the priority bus network, electronic enforcement points and volumetric counts from speed radars, on-street parking (rotating parking, spaces for older people and motorcycle couriers, and sales points), street segment gradients from 2007, and road traffic crash records with victims (occurrences, locations, vehicles and people involved), together with BHTRANS's open data plan. Coverage is the city of Belo Horizonte. The portal runs on CKAN with an API, and the datasets are free, 20 under Creative Commons Attribution and 4 under the Open Database Licence, almost all as CSV files; most were updated in 2026, while the radar counts date from 2023. Caveats: several older versions are marked deactivated or discontinued alongside their replacements, and the radar volumes cover only enforcement locations. The network, signal and traffic data support urban road network flow and capacity planning models, and crash records support hazard and safety analysis. It complements the ARTESP and ANTT open data for Brazilian highways.
